name: OpenRA/OpenRA
description: Open Source real-time strategy game engine for classic Westwood games (Command & Conquer, Red Alert) written in C# using SDL and OpenGL. Runs on Windows, Linux, macOS, and BSD.
score_rationale: 16.5k stars, highly polished RTS engine with active community, production-quality releases, and full support for classic C&C titles.
summary: Polished RTS engine for Command & Conquer and Red Alert games
